epoch_rule: the frozen rule applied to this site's sweep curve: smallest epoch whose mean held-out cross-class IIA is within 0.01 of the site's best (sweep_strict/sweep.csv)
rule:
- For each site take its best epoch by mean held-out cross-class IIA (folds
  pooled). Late sites control the readout almost linearly, so the highest
  IIA alone would favour them; the rule instead takes the **earliest** site
  whose best IIA is within 0.02 of the overall best and whose median
  positive-control fraction at that epoch is >= 0.5.
- Epochs: the smallest epoch at that site whose IIA is within 0.01 of the
  site's best.
Rank is chosen later, in `run_das_round2.py final`, by its own rule.
tost_rule: delta_s = 0.2 x held-out Delta log P(O) (intransitive base <- transitive source, mean over held-out pairs) from this site's final run, fixed before passive evaluation

tost.quantity: passive contrast D on delta log P(O) (transitive minus intransitive donor), after patching
tost.rule: equivalence ('no rise') if the 90% CI of D lies within +/- delta
